triggers.detailsText: We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, via a resolution passed through circulation on November 19, 2026, has approved the allotment of 33,28,686 (Thirty-Three Lakh Twenty-Eight Thousand Six Hundred and Eighty-Six) share warrants (“Warrants”) to Minerva Ventures Fund on Preferential basis through Private Placement. Key details of the allotment are as follows:  Each Warrant is convertible into, or exchangeable for, 1 (one) fully paid-up equity share of the Company of face value of ₹10/- each at a price of ₹645/- each (including a premium of ₹635/- per warrant).  The allotment has been made upon receipt of the upfront subscription amount of ₹161.25 per Warrant, equivalent to 25% of the total issue price.

The BCA could be downgraded if the banks' loan growth accelerates to a level materially higher than system loan growth, posing risks to asset quality, or if its tangible common equity / risk-weighted assets (TCE/RWA) ratio declines to below 11.0% or its net income/tangible assets ratio declines to below 0.5% on a sustained basis. In terms of revenue and the margins, in terms of the accounting numbers, I mean, by now you would have already realized, recognition is totally a function of the projects that are receiving occupation certificates and the number of units that have been handed over. So we should be, in terms of revenue recognition, we should be looking at a number again, which is roughly 10% higher than what has happened in FY26, and in terms of the margins, we should revert back to the margins that were shown or that we achieved in FY26.
